keyEvents.text: Goal! Millwall 1, Derby County 0. Kyrell Lisbie (Millwall) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lyndon Dykes.
Goal! Millwall 2, Derby County 0. Kyrell Lisbie (Millwall) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Caleb Taylor.
Goal! Millwall 3, Derby County 0. Luke Cundle (Millwall) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Camiel Neghli following a fast break.
Lyndon Dykes (Millwall) is shown the yellow card.
Derek Mazou-Sacko (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury David Ozoh (Derby County).
Substitution, Derby County. Alex Mowatt replaces David Ozoh because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Rhian Brewster (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Tristan Crama (Millwall).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Millwall 3, Derby County 0.
Delay in match (Millwall).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Derby County. Mohammed Fuseini replaces Henrik Meister.
Substitution, Millwall. Ryan Leonard replaces Tristan Crama.
Substitution, Millwall. Mihailo Ivanovic replaces Lyndon Dykes.
Carlton Morris (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Millwall. Mark Sykes replaces Camiel Neghli.
Substitution, Millwall. Alfie Doughty replaces Kyrell Lisbie.
Substitution, Derby County. Lars-Jørgen Salvesen replaces Carlton Morris.
Substitution, Derby County. Filip Bilbija replaces Sam Szmodics.
Substitution, Derby County. Oscar Fraulo replaces Rhian Brewster.
Substitution, Millwall. Romain Esse replaces Zak Sturge.
Goal! Millwall 4, Derby County 0. Jake Cooper (Millwall) left footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Mihailo Ivanovic following a corner.
Goal! Millwall 4, Derby County 1. Filip Bilbija (Derby County) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Jenson Metcalfe (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Millwall 4, Derby County 1.
